title: Community models branch into images
summary:
Community image providers, refreshed Gemini models, Laguna S 2.1, and simpler app submissions led a day of image API repairs.

Providers can register and test OpenAI-compatible image generation endpoints. Community image models support text-to-image requests through `/image/{prompt}` and `/v1/images/generations`, and the catalog separates them from community text models. Owners also gained Deactivate and Reactivate controls in My Models; the API documentation covers those controls and the image models’ text-to-image limits.

`gemini` and `gemini-search-large` moved to Gemini 3.6 Flash as Google text services were routed through OpenRouter, with Google Search tool support retained. Poolside’s Laguna S 2.1 joined the catalog as `laguna`, offering tools, optional reasoning, and a 1,048,576-token context. The dashboard also corrected its generations-per-Pollen ranking so free models appear first.

App submissions moved to an issue form, with automated pre-review and a maintainer publication decision; Enter registration is no longer required to submit. The community catalog also added Ai Anime Legends Generator and Arika.

highlights.title: Community image endpoints
highlights.text: Register an OpenAI-compatible image provider and use its text-to-image models through `/image/{prompt}` or `/v1/images/generations`. Community image generation responses use `b64_json`. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Pause your community model
highlights.text: Model owners can deactivate or reactivate a community model from My Models without changing its configuration. [Open the dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash
highlights.text: `gemini` and `gemini-search-large` now use Gemini 3.6 Flash, with Google Search tools supported through their updated routing. [Explore `gemini`](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini).

highlights.title: Laguna S 2.1
highlights.text: Try `laguna` for text tasks with tools, optional reasoning, and a 1,048,576-token context. [Explore `laguna`](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=laguna).

highlights.title: Simpler app submissions
highlights.text: Submit a community app with an issue form; Enter registration is no longer a prerequisite. Automated checks help prepare it for maintainer review. [Visit the repository](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations).
